The Consequences of Gen Z’s Risk Aversion

November 1, 2026

Katrina Trinko, Daily Signal, November 1, 2026

Share

Will Gen Z’s well-documented risk aversion mean fewer American babies?

A new study looks at what cultural factors do and don’t impact fertility rates—and found that “people with more willingness to take risks also intend to have more kids.” The data also shows that “where people are more willing to take risks, fertility is higher.”
